impact: 2,310 users experienced elevated latency for 80 minutes. Error rate peaked at 6.2%.
stated_cause: A bad deploy went out and caused elevated latency across the API tier.
contributing_factors: The deploy contained a change to the connection pool configuration.
The change was reverted once the team identified it as the source.
narrative: The on-call engineer received an alert at 14:02 and began investigating. The deploy was reverted at 14:41 and metrics recovered shortly after.

action_items.title: Review connection pool settings before deploys
Send the incident note to the engineering list
